text:
laura: Heads-up: kickoff for Cloud Marketplace listing preflight. Need owners for AMI/container, legal terms, SKU mapping, pricing matrix, telemetry hooks, and marketplace support flow. Goal: listing ready for upload in 2w.

miguel: I'll take AMI build + CI job. Plan: aws-ami pipeline that seeds marketplace metadata tag.

laura: thx miguel. olga-ops can you confirm VPC networking constraints for private offers?

olga-ops: For private offers we'll need customer VPC peering docs and optional VPN instructions. I'll draft networking appendix.

laura: good. tanya will cover legal?

tanya: Yes. I'll prepare marketplace-specific addendum and permission wording. One question: do we limit telemetry to anonymized usage or share account-level usage with vendor? Need decision.

jess-finance: Finance prefers anonymized metrics only. We can provide high-level meter events but not raw customer IDs. Need to update SOC docs too.

matt: Packaging note: GCP marketplace prefers container + deployment manager manifest; Azure wants ARM template. We'll need three manifest flavors. I'll create templates and a small validation script.

miguel: AMI build note: QEMU resizing step sometimes breaks if image > 50GB. I'll keep base smaller.

laura: Good catch. miguel, add a short runbook for rollback if AMI build fails in pipeline.

marketplace-bot: task created: marketplace/tasks/1755554321  assign: miguel, tanya, jess-finance, matt, olga-ops. playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/marketplace/onboard-preflight

jess-finance: Pricing question: do we map the same tier names across clouds or adapt regionally? I recommend canonical tiers (Starter/Pro/Enterprise) and region price multipliers. Also need trial entitlement caps per SKU.

tanya: Agreed on canonical tiers. Legal will accept tier names. Jess, can you propose default multipliers by Tue?

jess-finance: Yes, I'll send a spreadsheet with suggested multipliers + VAT flags by Tue EOD.

laura: Telemetry hooks: keystones: install probe (opt-in), token-usage event, error-rate metric. Keep PII out. Any objections?

matt: No objections. I'll add telemetry snippet to quickstart and examples for Marketplace docs.

laura: Also need support routing: cloud vendor expects an integration contact and an escalation play. Olga, can you draft a vendor-facing support matrix?

olga-ops: On it. Will include contact URIs, escalation SLA, and example tickets.

miguel: Quick note: for AWS private offers we must register product code after AMI upload. I'll add that to pipeline as a final step.

laura: Timeline recap: Week 1: AMI + container builds, manifest templates, legal addendum draft. Week 2: pricing final, documentation, support matrix, runbook + one internal dry-run publish to staging. If all green, file public listing in week 3.

tanya: I'll post the draft EULA addendum here when ready for review.

jess-finance: I'll attach pricing sheet and trial caps to this thread when ready.

matt: I'll push manifest validation script to repo: tools/marketplace/validate_manifests.sh

miguel: CI tickets: #infra-ami-build and #ci-marketplace-publish. Tagging infra on those.

laura: Perfect. Action items: @miguel AMI + CI, @matt manifests + telemetry snippet, @tanya legal addendum, @jess-finance pricing + trial caps, @olga-ops vendor support matrix. Update the playbook task when done. Thanks. :raised_hands:
